companion_input_contract.current_preparation_only: Root's current bounded input-only stage reads the fixed4 TRAIN canonical prepared xyz/original25 input features and existing gradient cells10/positive volumes, plus scalar metadata. companion_input_contract.levels: Role-homogeneous connected P0 aggregates with soft targets2048 fine and128 coarse; component/role constraints can exceed those targets. Hard safety limits4096/512 block preparation rather than silently violate constraints.
companion_input_contract.partition: Deterministic bounded-BFS growth on the original topology; no nearest-anchor geometric shortcut. Original BC bits0:7 must be homogeneous within each P0 aggregate.
companion_input_contract.full_mesh: Preserve original TETRA10 node IDs, including midside nodes; use the12 corner-midpoint subedges, not a corner-only graph that leaves midside nodes unconnected
companion_input_contract.node_to_fine: P0 is a fixed node-to-connected-aggregate one-hot map
companion_input_contract.prolongation: At both levels use fixed nonnegative row-stochastic P=J*J*P0, J=(1-omega)*I+omega*D^-1*W, omega=2/3, with valid isolated-node identity handling. Sparse maps retain all coefficients: no topK or threshold pruning.
companion_input_contract.meaning_of_positive: Nonnegative coefficients, no empty rows, each row sum1; exact sparse zero coefficients are allowed
companion_input_contract.level_transfer: P01[N, M0] and P12[M0, M1] CSR; each comes from its hard connected ownership and two-pass smoothing. Fine W uses binary positive topology; coarse W=P0^T*W*P0 with diagonal removed, retaining real interface edges. Positive lumped incidence proxy supplies input mass; do not use quadratic shape-function row sums as positive mass.
companion_input_contract.role_limit: Smoothing can mix distinct BC-role aggregates although hard P0 ownership is homogeneous. Original43 input channels remain active; these maps do not enforce a hard boundary condition.
companion_input_contract.same_input_cache: Both branches use identical aggregate ownership, edge topology, input descriptors, level-transfer maps and nodal prolongation

companion_input_contract.force_guard: Aggregate descriptors are geometry/static BC inputs only; if original features are used, clear slots7:13 before aggregation so the basis context is load independent
companion_input_contract.forbidden_context_inputs: No GT displacement/stress/strain, frozen predicted displacement, case ID embedding, validation/test labels or learned targets in topology inputs
